cues: To use a thermocouple as a thermometer, keep the cold junction in melting ice, a fixed zero degree reference, and put the hot junction where you want the temperature.
The meter reading is turned into a temperature with a calibration curve.
This is how the kilns of a brick factory, or a cement plant in Hetauda, are monitored, from a control room far away.
